name: runway
description: Switches subscriptions with claude-swap before a usage limit stops the work, resumes a session that a limit stopped, and, with tidy, suggests compacting before a long limit.

compactBeforeLimitTokens.title: Compaction reminder size before a limit
compactBeforeLimitTokens.description: Runway suggests compacting before a usage limit that resets after the prompt cache expires when the context is at least this many tokens, and only while tidy's compact tool is loaded. 0 turns the suggestion off.

switching.title: Account switching
switching.description: Switch to another account that claude-swap manages before a usage limit stops the work.

switchMaxWaitMinutes.title: Switch lead time
switchMaxWaitMinutes.description: Runway switches accounts when a usage window, at its current burn rate, would reach 99% within this many minutes plus a 5-minute margin. A target account must not be that close to a limit itself.

remoteControlRestore.title: Restore Remote Control
remoteControlRestore.description: Reconnect Remote Control after an account switch drops it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Send a desktop notification when account switching fails.
